_notes:
ams TSL2591 high dynamic range light sensor (visible and infrared photodiodes, 600M:1 range) at 0x29 (fixed). Each register access is a command byte: 0xA0 (CMD, normal transaction) | the register
Detection: ID (0x12, command 0xB2) = 0x50. identPriority 4 puts it before the VL53L0X, VL6180, VL53L1X, VL53L4CD and LTR-329 at 0x29: its detection read only sets those sensors' register index, while their detection writes (e.g. the VL6180's 16-bit index 0x0000, the VL53L1X's 0x010F) would reach it as data
Init: CONFIG (0x01) = 0x10 - medium gain (25x), 100 ms integration; then ENABLE (0x00) = 0x03 - power on, ALS on (no interrupts)
Poll (200 ms): CONFIG (0x01), then STATUS (0x13) and the two channels C0DATA (full spectrum, 0x14-0x15) and C1DATA (infrared, 0x16-0x17) in one read. valid is 1 when STATUS AVALID (bit 0) is set and neither channel is saturated (0xFFFF). The decode code calculates lux from the channels with ams's coefficients as Adafruit's library does: lux = (full - ir) x (1 - ir / full) / cpl, cpl = integration time (ms) x gain / 408, using the gain and integration time read from CONFIG, so the gain action needs no other change
Gain (action): low (1x, for bright light), medium (25x, the default), high (428x) or max (9876x, for very dim light); the integration time stays 100 ms. In bright light at a high gain the channels saturate and valid is 0
Source: the lux calculation and its coefficients are from Adafruit's TSL2591 library (https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_TSL2591_Library, calculateLux), BSD-3-Clause; see RaftCore's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for its notice. Registers from the ams TSL2591 datasheet

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-26, powered down and then measuring): 0x99 is a command with a reserved transaction type; the read returns 30 93 42 40 then zeros. ENABLE, CONFIG, the thresholds (0x00-0x07) and PERSIST (0x0C) unchanged; measuring carried on (AVALID set, the channels the same before and after). Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway

c.c: int cfg=buf[0];int g=(cfg>>4)&3;int t=cfg&7;float again=1.0;if(g==1){again=25.0;}if(g==2){again=428.0;}if(g==3){again=9876.0;}float atime=100.0*(t+1);int ch0=buf[2]|(buf[3]<<8);int ch1=buf[4]|(buf[5]<<8);int valid=0;float lux=0.0;if(((buf[1]&1)==1)&&(ch0<65535)&&(ch1<65535)&&(ch0>0)){float cpl=(atime*again)/408.0;lux=((ch0-ch1)*(1.0-(ch1/(ch0*1.0))))/cpl;if(lux<0.0){lux=0.0;}valid=1;}out.lux=lux;out.full=ch0;out.ir=ch1;out.valid=valid;next;

actions.desc: Gain (integration time 100 ms): low for bright light, max for very dim light
